ann.t: Press Release — Advani Hotels & Resorts (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 14, 2026, titled "Press  Release dated Aug 14, 2026 on unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Advani Hotels & Resorts (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Updates — Advani Hotels & Resorts (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Complaint against lnfinHub Market Technologies FZ-LLC for a serious andblatant violation of SEBI regulations and a request for the passing of a cease anddesist order and other enforcement action against it.'.

Press Release — Advani Hotels & Resorts (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 25, 2026, titled "Audited Financial Results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026.".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Advani Hotels & Resorts (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.

Cessation — Advani Hotels & Resorts (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Deepesh Joishar as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. February 20, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Advani Hotels & Resorts (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
